map.（Aspect Ratio）= 开孔宽度 / 钢网厚度，建议 ≥ 1.5: (Aspect Ratio) = aperture width / stencil thickness, 1.5 or above recommended

map.为何开孔要比焊盘小？: Why are apertures smaller than pads?
map.避免锡膏溢出桥连；引脚/焊盘小 10~20% 是经验值（IPC 7525）。本工: To stop paste overflowing and bridging; making apertures 10~20% smaller than leads or pads is the rule of thumb (IPC 7525).
